_comment: Capability classification for the docs ecosystem map (docs/public/capability-status.json + /ecosystem page). Hand-authored. Tier authority is the capability-reconciliation effort; this file records that classification — the generator (scripts/capability-status.ts) NEVER infers a tier, it only joins `packages` against docs/public/graph.json and fails if a referenced package does not exist. Tier enum: demonstrated (a human has seen it work first-hand) | undemonstrated (built + tested, no captured human-visible proof) | over-claimed (docs/vision assert more than exists) | missing (named but not built). 'evidence.kind': run (a command/example run first-hand) | test | story | doc | live.

ACL deny path raised MemoryAclError — a real permission demonstration.

Adapters tested; no captured side-by-side harness session.
